entities.name: Lorenz Florenz Friedrich von Crell
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lorenz Florenz Friedrich von Crell was a German chemist. In 1778 he started publishing the first periodical journal focusing on chemistry. The journal had a longer title but was known simply as Crell's Annalen.
